related_missing_formula_status: NOT_RECOVERED; this is a new candidate and not a reconstruction

definition.factor_transform: SQL percent_rank ascending within each formation month, calculated only among non-null values for that factor
definition.selection: rank by score descending, select top 20; never filter candidates by next-month outcome availability before ranking
definition.gross_return: average(next-calendar-month adjusted close/current adjusted close - 1) across the same 20 selected symbols
definition.turnover: 1 - intersection_count(current_top20, prior_month_top20)/20; first month turnover is 1.0
definition.missing_outcome_policy: if any selected symbol lacks a valid next-calendar-month adjusted close, do not compute or substitute a monthly return; mark that formation month/run incomplete

research_run.missing_selected_symbol_policy: kept the formation-date top 20; did not substitute rank 21; did not persist a fabricated August 2026 return
research_run.cost_calibration: 0.002 return fraction per 1.0 turnover inferred from previously stored gross/net series; stress tests also use 0.003 and 0.004

historical_diagnostics_at_20bp_cost.statistical_caution: The retrospective OOS contains only 12 monthly observations; the approximate 95% interval for mean monthly return includes zero. These are not statistically persuasive results.
